_comment: The AI companies a church can bring its own key from (onboarding spec S8, lane N5), and the models for AI on this Mac (S9).
Data, not code: own_key.rs reads it, own_key_tests.rs pins it. Values from the vendors' own pages (provider research and
the vendor docs check, 2026-11-17). Each company's verified_live is false until the owner's live test passes for it
(decision 19). All three passed on 2026-11-18 with the owner's own keys: the key check, and a question that took three
or four rounds with lookups. reasoning_effort_with_tools stays off for Gemini: its tool steps completed without it.
local.reasoning_effort goes with every request to a model on this Mac: Ollama's docs say "none" asks for no thinking
(GPT-OSS, which can't stop, thinks at its lowest level). qwen3:8b spent all of the check's tokens thinking without it
local.<size>.offered: Ozzie downloads and sets it up. qwen3:4b is not offered: with thinking off it thinks aloud in its
words, and with Ozzie's exact check it never reached the lookup within 200, 400, 800 or 1,500 tokens, thinking off or on
(0 of 18, measured 2026-11-18); its entry stays so Ozzie's own copy and download can still be removed. tested: Ozzie's
check and a real Ask were run against it on a Mac; only a tested model is recommended. gpt-oss:20b can't be run on the
16 GB Mac the tests were made on, so it is offered where it fits but never recommended until tested.

presets.name: ChatGPT
presets.retention_line: OpenAI doesn't train its models on what apps send through a key unless you choose to share it, and keeps it for up to 30 days to watch for abuse, longer only if the law requires it or to protect its services.

presets.name: Claude
presets.retention_line: Anthropic doesn't use what apps send through a key to train its models by default, and deletes it within 30 days unless it is flagged for a policy violation or the law requires longer.
presets.key_note: When you create the key, choose a workspace for it, and choose Never for when it expires (if Never isn't offered, pick the longest time) unless your church's policy says otherwise.

presets.name: Gemini
presets.retention_line: On the paid plan, Google doesn't use what the app sends to improve its products, and keeps it for a limited time to watch for misuse.
presets.free_plan_line: On the free plan, Google may use what the app sends to improve its products, and people at Google may read it. Google says not to send sensitive or personal information on the free plan.

local.ollama_start: Press Open Ollama, and Ozzie carries on once Ollama answers.
local.lm_studio_start: LM Studio's server doesn't start by itself. In LM Studio, open the Developer tab and turn on Start server, then press Look again.
